Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: EQ Sentry Nepal earthquake safety website carousel illustration.
Create ONE finished landscape 16:9 image. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, border, separate panels, or infographic labels.
Shared art direction: crisp, sophisticated flat editorial illustration with restrained architectural/isometric depth. Dark charcoal background #171C27 filling the entire canvas; slate blue-gray objects and off-white highlights #EEF1F6; dominant seismic vermilion-orange #FF4D2E accent and small warm orange #FF8A3D details. Strong clean silhouettes, subtle shading, thin precise outlines, ample breathing room, mature public-information design. Never a photograph, sketch, neon sci-fi art, or cartoon mascot. Consistent with a minimalist dark earthquake-monitoring website.
Composition: one focused scene centered in the frame. Fill about 75 percent of the image with the subject; keep 10 percent safety margins and the upper-left corner quiet for an overlaid step badge. Essential instructional details must remain clear in a small card. Complete objects must fit, never crop people or safety equipment. Human figures when needed have natural South Asian skin tones, ordinary modern Nepal-appropriate casual clothes in vermilion-orange and slate, clear normal anatomy, calm serious demeanor.
Educational accuracy: illustrate the described action without adding unsafe behavior or implying official certification. For buildings, conceptual educational illustration, no measurements or construction specifications.
Specific subject: Secure heavy household furniture before an earthquake. Show a tall slate bookcase standing against a short interior wall, with two strong vermilion anchor straps and brackets visibly joining the upper bookcase to the wall. A few restrained books neatly sit on the shelves and heavier objects sit low. Close enough that the two anchors are the unmistakable focal point. No person needed; the bookcase is stable and upright.
